status.label: Needs visible diagnostics
status.detail: The Mouse Finder failure has a maintainer request and author reply, but the promised diagnostic ZIPs are not visible in the GitHub thread.

next_action.label: Ask author to attach diagnostics on GitHub
next_action.reason: The current public thread does not contain the bug report ZIP or logs needed to distinguish configuration, graphics, or input-hook failures.

comment.body: Thanks for the follow-up. Could you attach the PowerToys bug report ZIP directly in a GitHub comment, then confirm whether Find My Mouse is enabled, which activation method is selected, whether PowerToys is running elevated, and whether the black-screen/white-circle behavior happens every time or only after repeated Ctrl presses?

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirmed abnormal Mouse Finder behavior after a maintainer asked for logs, but the diagnostic ZIPs mentioned in the reply are not visible in the GitHub issue thread.
evidence: Issue body: pressing Ctrl twice no longer activates Mouse Finder on PowerToys 0.100.2.
Maintainer asked for a bug report, better repro steps, or error logs.
Reporter replied that repeated presses can produce a black screen and white circle, but no visible ZIP attachment or logs appear in the thread.
judgment.recommended_action: Draft a request asking the reporter to attach the bug report ZIP directly on GitHub and confirm Find My Mouse settings/elevation/repro consistency.
